attributes.description: Downstream and upstream DOCSIS channel health for a NETGEAR cable modem: locked channel counts, per channel power and SNR, and codeword error rates. Use the dropdowns to narrow to one direction, modulation or channel.
Distinct downstream channel identifiers the modem reports as locked. Counted as distinct identifiers because every poll writes a fresh row for every channel slot.

query.query: data_stream.dataset: "netgear_genie.channel" and netgear_genie.channel.locked: true and netgear_genie.channel.type: "downstream"

attributes.title: Locked downstream channels

attributes.description: Distinct upstream channel identifiers the modem reports as locked.

attributes.title: Locked upstream channels

attributes.description: Worst signal to noise ratio across the locked downstream channels. Unlocked slots report 0.0 dB, so the panel is scoped to locked channels.

panelsJSON.title: Locked channels by direction and modulation

attributes.description: Received level per locked downstream channel. The reference lines mark the -7 to +7 dBmV range a CM1000 is happy in. Unlocked slots report 0.0 dBmV, so they are filtered out before averaging.

attributes.title: Downstream power by channel

attributes.description: Signal to noise ratio per locked downstream channel. The reference line marks 33 dB, the floor for reliable QAM256. Unlocked slots report 0.0 dB and are filtered out.

attributes.title: Downstream SNR by channel

attributes.description: Transmit level per locked upstream channel. The reference lines mark the 35 to 51 dBmV working range; a modem climbing towards the top of it is compensating for upstream loss.

attributes.title: Upstream power by channel

attributes.description: The modem reports codeword counters cumulatively since boot, so this panel charts the change between intervals rather than the raw counter. A single deep negative bar is the counter resetting on a modem reboot, not an improvement.

attributes.title: Uncorrectable codewords per interval

attributes.description: Correctable codewords rising on their own is normal forward error correction work. Uncorrectable codewords rising is real impairment on the plant.

attributes.description: Codewords the modem could not correct, relative to every codeword it received on that channel over the selected time range. Counters reset when the modem reboots, so a range that spans a reboot measures the period after it.
